| # BDS Flashing Tool {#bds-flashing-tool-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}           |                                                                                                                                                   |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

BDS Flashing tool is a script used for the software update of RC5-6/40, RC18-12/40 or RC27-18/40.

## Contents of BDS Flashing tool package {#contents-of-bds-flashing-tool-package .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

BDS Flashing tool contains following packages:

 

oFlashing tool EXE file

oBatch script to start the flashing procedure

oPython script

oAll needed DLLs for CAN-USB library

oConfig.ini to configure:

§Hex file to be flashed

§Baud Rate

§Report log text file path

§Flashing mode

 

Details on the full list of arguments and how to configure them are mentioned in the next chapter.
